label: First main fork inland from Melford Creek
identity_evidence: Inland from the narrow estuary immediately west of Melford Point and southwest of Bear Head. Follow the paired estuary banks to the southeastern stream, then its first main southern/southeastern fork. Modern Melford Brook segments 273245 vertex 0 and 273246 vertex 31 meet eastern tributary 197305 vertex 153 exactly. The source simplifies the southeastern meanders and omits the separate west-side estuary tributary; that estuary tributary is not confused with the selected fork farther inland. The large coastal head, estuary position and fork order corroborate identity. The selected pixel is on the single-line junction, not the tide-dependent estuary head or shoreline.
phase: First fresh physical check selected after affine14 freeze. Excluded from its 14 controls and all 28 model-selection diagnostics; no tuning.
